details:
Description

In some worlds, my character starts spinning by itself when I enter an elevator, or when the elevator stops. I've seen it in a few worlds, but it's really noticeable in "Between" by Sournetic, because you spawn inside a moving elevator and it starts right away.

The spinning never stops on its own. When I try to move, my character sways side to side in a wavy motion, so I can't control where I go. Sometimes my character also slowly moves backward by itself. If I leave it for about 10 minutes, the spin flips to the other direction and my character starts jumping nonstop.

It seems the only way to fix it is to respawn outside of the elevator. Then the problem goes away. But if I enter the elevator again, the problem comes back and won't stop until I respawn. This is not caused by my avatar. I tried several different avatars and it happens with all of them.

Reproduction Steps

1. Open VRChat

2. Join the world Between by Sournetic

3. Spawn in, or enter an elevator

4. My character starts spinning when I enter and/or when the elevator stops moving, and I lose control

5. Try to move, the spinning doesn't stop and the movement is wavy, and sometimes the character slowly drifts backward

6. After about 10 minutes, the spin reverses and the character starts jumping continuously.

Workaround: the only way to fix it is to respawn outside of the elevator, which makes the problem go away.

Details

- Category: World

- Frequency: Always
